question: Why was a poor man's cloak taken as a pledge to be returned by sunset?
options: So he could sleep in it, and he would bless you, counting as righteousness before God
So he could sell it the next day
So the lender would not lose it
So he could wear it to the festival
explanation: A poor man's cloak was his covering at night, so it had to be returned by sunset; he would then bless the lender, and it would be credited as righteousness before the Lord.
